title: Create：Small Generator
description: Add machines to Create that allow conversion between kinetic power and electric power.
body:
## Introduction

Converts between Create's stress system (SU) and FE energy systems.

## Added Content

**Kinetic Dynamo** - Consumes stress to generate FE energy  
**Electric Motor** - Consumes FE energy to generate stress

## Configuration

All parameters can be adjusted in `config/create_small_generator-common.toml`:

*   Energy conversion efficiency
*   Stress capacity
*   Transfer rate
*   Storage capacity

\=============================

## 简介

在机械动力的应力系统和FE能量之间进行双向转换。

## 添加内容

**动力发电机** - 消耗应力产生 FE 能量  
**电动马达** - 消耗 FE 能量产生应力

## 配置

所有参数可在 `config/create_small_generator-common.toml` 中调整：

*   能量转换效率
*   应力容量
*   传输速率
*   存储容量
